title: Neurobehavioral Impacts of the Autism Risk Gene, WAC: Studies Involving C. elegans and Mice.
abstract: WAC deletion in C. elegans and mice alters multiple neurotransmitter-associated behaviors. Mutant worms show enhanced cholinergic transmission via increased nicotinic acetylcholine receptor activity, reduced motility and dopamine-associated behaviors. Wac mice show an inverse correlation between Wac mRNA and CHRNA7. WAC is linked to DeSanto-Shinawi syndrome and proposed as an ASD risk gene.
